title: fix(cli): os serve with the stdio MCP transport and no config argument answers an initialize written at spawn — its config positional no longer reads stdin
body:
Fixes #24191

Clause-②: no

`os serve` with the stdio MCP transport enabled and no config argument now answers the `initialize` an MCP client writes when it spawns the server, and it boots the configured app.

## What was wrong (re-measured on `origin/main` `f963d8e2b`, built CLI through `bin/run.js`)

- **H1 holds.** `serve`'s `config` positional (the `Args.string` at about `serve.ts:1400`) had no `ignoreStdin`. In `@oclif/core` 5.1.2 (`lib/parser/parse.js`), `_args()` calls `tryStdin` for every positional that has no token, unless the arg sets `ignoreStdin`. A line already waiting in the pipe becomes the value.
- The fixture is the shape the card names: a host config (`defineStack` plus a plugin that writes a marker from `start()`), a compiled `dist/objectstack.json` beside it, a key minted through `serve --dev` and `POST /keys`, and `os serve` with `OS_MCP_STDIO_ENABLED=true`, that key and `NODE_ENV` unset (production). The `initialize` is written at spawn in both rows.

| shape | before (`f963d8e2b`) | after |
|---|---|---|
| `os serve -p PORT --no-ui` (no config argument) | no answer within 60 s; `No objectstack.config.ts found — booting from artifact (default host)...` beside the config; host plugin marker absent | answered (`id` 24191); host plugin marker present |
| control: `os serve objectstack.config.ts -p PORT --no-ui` | answered, config loaded (1 passed) | unchanged |

## The fix (`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts`)

`ignoreStdin: true` on `serve`'s `config` positional. Stdin belongs to the stdio transport; the config path comes from argv or the default. The fix sits at the producer, the parser declaration that let a protocol message become a config path. Nothing downstream changes, and no consumer gains a fallback.

The one input-surface change: an omitted config argument is no longer read from stdin. **H2 holds** on this tree:
- a config piped into `serve`, `start` or `compile` (a pipe into `os`, `objectstack` or `bin/run(-dev).js` followed by one of those commands): **0** hits;
- a stdin redirect into those commands: **0** real hits (the 6 regex hits are prose placeholders such as a bracketed "config dir" after `os serve`);
- `stdin.write(` / `stdin.end(` under `packages/cli`: **5** hits, 3 login prompts and 2 JSON-RPC `initialize` writes, none of them a config path.

The changeset states the change and its remedy: pass the path as the argument.

## Re-grounding `serve-mcp-stdio-answers.e2e.test.ts` (#7645), not dropping it

**H3 holds, measured.** That file spawns `serve` with no positional because oclif's `tryStdin` used to pause stdin, and a paused stdin is the premise of the `resume()` in `MCPServerRuntime.start()`. After this fix nothing in the spawned CLI pauses stdin, so the premise was gone:

| e2e file | `resume()` removed (local ablation of `packages/mcp`, rebuilt, marker in 2 built files) | `resume()` restored |
|---|---|---|
| as on `f963d8e2b` | **passed**: vacuous, it no longer guards `resume()` | passed |
| re-grounded (this PR) | **RED**: `the stdio transport started but never answered initialize`, after its premise assertion passed | passed |

The re-grounded stdio boot runs with a `--import` preload, a `data:` URL so the whole host stays on the page. The preload is the "host that touched stdin before `start()`" that the `resume()` comment names. It pauses `process.stdin` before the CLI loads, which is what readline's `Interface.close()` did under oclif. It also prints `readableFlowing` each time a `data` listener attaches. The test asserts every reported state is `false`, so the premise is measured on every run. A later change that resumes stdin earlier cannot make the file vacuous again without reddening it. The file still passes no positional, the form users type, and still asserts a parsed answer.

The `packages/mcp` ablation was local only. It was restored through `ablation-replace.mjs` (blob `3ef6ce641` equals HEAD), the rebuilt `dist/` no longer carries the marker (6 files), and the tree is clean. The file is nightly-tier by name, so this PR's CI does not run it. The readings above are local.

## Pin

`packages/cli/test/serve-mcp-stdio-early-initialize.integration.test.ts` is in the `integration` tier, because it spawns `bin/run.js`. It runs one minting `serve --dev` boot, one `os compile` for the artifact, and then the boot under test with no config argument and the `initialize` written at spawn. It asserts:

1. A parseable JSON-RPC frame with the request's own `id` (24191), no `error`, a `protocolVersion` and a `serverInfo.name`.
2. The host config's plugin marker on stderr: the config was composed, not the artifact beside it.

Before the boot it asserts the positive control: `dist/objectstack.json` exists. The artifact is what makes the defect silent. Without one, a swallowed config path is a loud "Nothing to serve" exit.

The budget line is 15 s: 11.6 s, the slowest of four local runs on a shared container, x 1.25. There is no CI reading yet. The pin spawns `bin/run.js`, so `scripts/check-cli-test-child-env.mjs`'s pinned built-entrypoint population gains it, going from eleven to twelve files, with the `Joined the population deliberately` note every member carries.

**Reverse verification.** The fix was committed first (`49bd321ea`). Both legs went through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (wrapped restore) and `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs`, with the CLI rebuilt for each leg.

- **Mutate** (`, ignoreStdin: true` deleted): the marker is absent from all 652 built files, and the pin is **RED**: `initialize was never answered` / `no answer within 60000 ms`, with `No objectstack.config.ts found — booting from artifact (default host)...` in the transcript.
- **Restore:** blob `cd1aa3d29` equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The rebuilt `dist/` carries the marker again, the tree is clean, and the pin then passed three times.

Predicted direction: red. Observed: red.

## Local verification (head `749f1a281`, after merging `origin/main` `e46ce7b6c`)

- A full `turbo run build` (76/76 tasks) ran first, because the merge moved `packages/spec`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0. `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit --listFiles` lists both changed test files.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2`: 310 files, 4599 tests passed.
- `vitest run --project integration` on the new pin and `start-mcp-stdio-early-initialize.integration.test.ts`: 2 passed. The `os start` pin was run because its `serve` child is the command changed here. The rest of the `integration` tier is declared to CI.
- `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly vitest run --project integration test/serve-mcp-stdio-answers.e2e.test.ts`: 1 passed.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 87 commands, and all 87 exited 0 (each exit captured before any pipe). `--ran` reconciled: `87 derived, 87 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`. This includes `check:cli-test-child-env` (15 built-CLI spawns, all out of `development`/`test`), `check:pm-dispatch-gates` (1884 cases), `check:nul-bytes`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage`.
- Edited gate script: `node scripts/check-cli-test-child-env.mjs --self-test` passed 152 cases. No test suite exercises the script; its only other mention is prose in `serve-node-env-production-default.e2e.test.ts`.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` over the four changed source files: exit 0, no output. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- The comment beside the `resume()` in `packages/mcp/src/mcp-server-runtime.ts` still says that `os serve --dev` with no path leaves stdin paused under oclif. After this PR that is history, not the current mechanism. The comment's general reason still holds: any host that touched stdin before `start()`. `packages/mcp` is outside this card's surface, so it is noted here and not edited.
- `os compile`'s optional `config` positional (no default, no `ignoreStdin`) still reads a pending stdin line. `compile` is not an MCP door, and `os start`'s compile spawn already gives it no stdin. Noted only.
- `os dev` is unchanged and is not a stdio door (see PR #24184's notes).
- The e2e's preload stands in for a host that pauses stdin; it is not a production caller. After this PR no production door pauses stdin before the transport attaches. Measured: the e2e as it stood on `f963d8e2b` passes with `resume()` removed.
